note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(互联网主题,独立短文,不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题,答案转述非照抄,2题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: Ben used to share his home address and phone number on every website he joined. One day a stranger used that information to enter his account, and Ben felt very upset. After that, he chose a strong password for each account and never gave out his private details again.

questions.q: What mistake did Ben make at first?
options: He revealed his personal information across many sites.
He never went online at all.
He refused to make any account.
questions.explanation: 原文 'used to share his home address and phone number on every website' 的转述;其余与原文相反或未提。

questions.q: What did Ben do after the problem happened?
options: He chose strong passwords and kept his details private.
He blamed his friends for it.
questions.explanation: 末句 'chose a strong password for each account and never gave out his private details again'(短文后半段,覆盖不同位置)。
